verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a dedicated sandbox mode, including server-level sandbox mode and fake bounce generation (postmark-docs-43, postmark-docs-19). It also offers a `POSTMARK_API_TEST` token for testing without actually sending email (postmark-docs-12), and separate servers can be created via API to isolate test traffic from production (postmark-docs-51). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of sandbox behavior and data isolation (the evidence is mostly headings), and independent or hands-on corroboration that sandbox testing works as described.
